Senses.Explanation: There is serious business ahead is a warning that failure to understand or premature claims of completion will have grave consequences. Chan masters place it directly after a failed test, an unresolved case, or an assertion that nothing remains to be done. Zishui warns those unable to understand two raised sayings; Juelang says that even producing escape lines for four cases leaves serious business; Shitian warns anyone unable to accept his summer instruction; and Yongjue rejects casual claims that eating and sleeping settle the matter.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: An ordinary warning becomes a stable adverse cap after failed understanding or premature claims of completion.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The phrase signals an unresolved major matter in its local tests; it does not specify one uniform future punishment.

DifferentThingTest.Reason: Both are the warning’s single forward-looking force; the different preceding failures are applications.
